brief: How a solo founder ships like a Meta team — 8 internal tools every operator should clone.

slots.body: Solo founders don't need headcount to move fast. They need the right internal stack.

slots.title: Centralize your
slots.body: Notion or Obsidian becomes your internal wiki. Store SOPs, docs, and notes in one searchable hub so nothing lives in a DM.

slots.title: Run a tight
slots.body: Linear or Height replaces hallway standups. Define owners, deadlines, and blockers so every feature ships on time without chaos.

slots.title: Build a content
slots.body: Figma templates, AI drafts, and a Notion calendar let one person produce and distribute like a full creative department daily.

slots.title: Wire an
slots.body: Zapier or Make connects your leads, invoices, and alerts. Automate the busywork so you only touch exceptions that matter.

slots.title: Own your
slots.body: A simple Looker Studio or Notion dashboard tracks North Star metrics. Review weekly to kill assumptions and double down fast.

slots.title: Deploy an
slots.body: Custom GPTs and agent workflows handle research, replies, and reporting. You become the operator, not the labor.
Pick one tool this week and wire it up. Speed comes from systems, not more hours.
